records.title: Powerful_Starro
records.evidence: Powerful Starro are Starro. Alongside the Ordinary Starro they are the predominant Starro mobs in the Starro: Spreading Spores duos and the Starro: Invasion! alerts in the Deluge episode and also appear in the Starro: The Threat Below raid.

records.title: Powerful_Starro_Splitter

records.title: Powers_Boothe
records.evidence: A photo of Powers Boothe. Powers Boothe was an actor and a voice actor. He provided the voice for Gorilla Grodd in the Justice League and Justice League Unlimited animated series.

records.title: Powerset_Tendril_Cloak_Cache
records.evidence: The Powerset Tendril Cloak Cache is a box which can be obtained from Love Conquers All 2025, the Valentine's Day Event, by completing the event with daily progress. It allows you to choose one of the Tendril Cloak styles, but it can only be claimed once.

records.title: Powersuit_Tights

Those items can only be obtained by players with the Halls of Power Part I episode from Mobs in all episode content. Random items of the collection can also be granted in the Omnibus Reward Cache.

records.title: Relics_of_the_Underworld
records.evidence: Relics of the Underworld is a collection comprised of twelve souvenirs related to Underworld beasts. Most of those can be gathered from Amazon Fury Part III On Duty instances if gear which grants Divine Favor is worn or you have completed the feat Divine Favor. One item must be bought and is solely available from the Olympian Equipment Supplier in Typhon's Monster Invasion.

records.title: Remnants_of_Rage
records.evidence: Remnants of Rage is a collection comprised of eight item that were left over by the Red Lantern Corps. These items can only be obtained by players with the War of the Light Part I episode from collection nodes found around the Downtown Metropolis Battlezone.

records.title: Remnants_of_the_Martyr
records.evidence: The Wings of the Betrayed are a rare style item in the back costume class. The are associated with the Red Lantern Corpsman Bleez.

records.title: Remnants_of_the_Minotaur
records.evidence: Remnants of the Minotaur is a collection comprised of ten souvenirs related to Minotaurs. Most of those can be gathered from Amazon Fury Part III raids and alerts if gear which grants Divine Favor is worn or you have completed the feat Divine Favor. One item must be bought and is solely available from the Olympian Equipment Supplier in Typhon's Monster Invasion.

records.title: Renewal_Wedding_Vow
records.evidence: Renewal Wedding Vow is a collection unique to the 2011 Valentine's Day Event. The set is comprised of four items, all of which can be obtained from Collection nodes all over Gotham City and Metropolis. It is also one of four Collections that comprise the Wedding Vows metacollection, also unique to the event.

records.title: Renown_Booster_Box_Four-Pack
